    Module

    src/ShiftPlanner.Api/Controllers

    Layer api · project ShiftPlanner.Api · Controllers: 12, API endpoints: 59

    Project navigation: ShiftPlanner.Api

    Overview 🤖

    Contains controllers for managing various aspects of shift planning, including absences, authentication, contracts, and employees.

    Responsibilities. Manages HTTP endpoints for shift planning, authentication, and employee data.

    Usage. The frontend's services and views call these endpoints to interact with shift planning data.

    AI draft from the facts on this page; review it, then write the module's documentation yourself.

    AbsencesController

    class · AbsencesController.cs ⚠

    🤖 Manages absences for employees, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting absences.

    • dependencies (fact): ApplicationDbContext, Absence
    • responsibilities (🤖 draft): Handles HTTP requests for absences, interacting with the database through the ApplicationDbContext.
    • behaviour (🤖 draft): Provides endpoints to get absences for a specific employee, get a single absence by ID, create a new absence, update an existing absence, and delete an absence.
    • side effects (🤖 draft): Writes to the database when creating, updating, or deleting absences.
    • exception (🤖 draft): Returns 404 when an employee or absence is not found. Returns 400 when creating or updating an absence with invalid data.

    EmployeesController

    class · EmployeesController.cs ⚠

    🤖 Manages employee data, including retrieving, creating, and updating employee records.

    • dependencies (fact): ApplicationDbContext, HoursBalanceCalculator, GermanPublicHolidays, WorkingTimeCalculator, HoursReportDayDto, HoursReportShiftDto, HoursReportDto, HoursAdjustmentDto, Employee, ShiftTypeDto, ShiftTypePreferenceDto, ShiftTypePreference, WeekdayPreferenceDto, WeekdayPreference
    • responsibilities (🤖 draft): Handles HTTP requests for employee data, including fetching all employees, retrieving a single employee by ID, calculating hours balance, generating hours reports, and managing employee creation and updates.
    • behaviour (🤖 draft): Processes HTTP GET and POST requests to interact with employee data. For GET requests, it retrieves employees based on the route and parameters. For POST requests, it creates new employees and updates existing ones.
